name: Walking
description: A purposeful walk at any pace, from an easy reset around the block to a long city route. It is a simple way to build daily movement, clear your head, and support recovery without adding much training stress.

name: Hiking
description: A trail-based walk that can include uneven ground, elevation, weather, and a pack. Log hikes when the terrain and time outdoors make the session feel more intentional than an everyday walk.

name: Running
description: Continuous running on roads, paths, tracks, or treadmills. This is a flexible log for easy mileage, tempo efforts, interval sessions, and any run where you want the complete duration saved.

name: Trail Running
description: Running on trails where changing surfaces, climbs, descents, and technical footing are part of the challenge. Use this separately from road running when terrain is a meaningful part of the effort.

name: Biking
description: A bike ride for fitness, commuting, exploration, or recovery. This flexible entry fits outdoor rides and trainer sessions when you want to keep the focus on how long you were moving.

name: Mountain Biking
description: Off-road cycling over trails, roots, rocks, and elevation changes. It captures the physical effort and technical focus of a ride where terrain matters as much as distance.

name: Swimming
description: A continuous swim session in a pool or open water. Log relaxed laps, structured intervals, or long steady swims whenever you want a clear record of the time you spent in the water.

name: Rock Climbing
description: Roped climbing indoors or outside, with repeated routes, belaying, and focused movement. This is for sessions where endurance, grip, technique, and problem solving all share the work.

name: Bouldering
description: Short, powerful climbing problems without ropes, usually with plenty of rest and repeated attempts. Use this when strength, technique, and working through difficult moves define the session.

name: Rowing
description: A rowing-machine, boat, or erg session that combines strong leg drive with a steady full-body rhythm. It works for easy aerobic rows, hard intervals, and longer endurance pieces.

name: Kayaking
description: A paddling session on lakes, rivers, or coastal water. Log it when the time spent moving, steering, and working through the water is the thing you want to remember.

name: Canoeing
description: A canoe trip or training paddle, whether you are covering distance, exploring a route, or working through changing conditions. It is a calm but deceptively complete outdoor effort.

name: Cross-Country Skiing
description: A Nordic skiing session that builds endurance through continuous full-body movement. Use it for a relaxed ski, a long route, or a harder interval day on groomed or natural snow.

name: Downhill Skiing
description: A lift-accessed day or focused session on downhill terrain. It records the time you spent skiing, from a casual day on the hill to a demanding stretch of steep or technical runs.

name: Snowboarding
description: A snowboarding session on groomed runs, powder, parks, or backcountry terrain. Use it to capture a day that blends leg endurance, balance, control, and time on the mountain.

name: Dance
description: A class, practice, rehearsal, or free-form session built around rhythm and movement. It is a great way to log active time that develops coordination, expression, and conditioning together.

name: Team Sport
description: A game, practice, scrimmage, or skill session for any field, court, or rink sport. Record the full session when the mix of running, repeated effort, and competition is what matters.

name: Martial Arts
description: A class, drilling session, sparring round, or technical practice in any martial art. It is a place to capture the time spent on skill, conditioning, discipline, and controlled intensity.

name: Mobility Flow
description: An intentional movement session focused on range of motion, control, and feeling better in your body. It is ideal for a longer mobility practice that deserves more context than a quick stretch.
